title: ranunculus papilionaceus
intro: Ranunculus papilionaceus, commonly known as the lesser clematis or woodman's clematis, is a plant species within the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of R. papilionaceus include ranunculin, a toxic compound that can be used to treat certain skin conditions, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a treatment for skin infections, wounds, and fever, as well as its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
